name: Rowe Electronics
old_description: Rowe Electronics is a full-service harness and engineering company that is committed to delivering best-in-class solutions and products. Customer service is our number one priority and we hold ourselves accountable to always providing a 5-star experience for our clientele. As both a company and individuals, we value quality, integrity, honesty, and professionalism at all times. Our experience and attention to detail allows us to administer first-class responsiveness to today’s demands while remaining cost-effective. From design through delivery, Rowe Electronics stands behind its products and customers.
about:
Rowe Electronics operates from Norwalk, Iowa. The company traces its roots to humble beginnings, eventually becoming a recognized supplier of microprocessor-based remote control systems, though the founding year and original founders are not specified in public materials.

The firm provides full-service harness and engineering capabilities, delivering custom manufacturing of RF systems, wireless throttle controls, and wire harnesses for mobile equipment. Its engineering services span controls, electronics, and prototype development, including turnkey digital, analog, and power design, industrial interfaces, harness routing, packaging, testing, and prototyping with design reviews and on-site support. The company emphasizes a seamless transition from design to production, working within client-preferred software and supply chains.

Rowe serves agriculture, transportation, recreation, and industrial sectors, with a focus on mobile equipment manufacturers and OEMs integrating accessory or complete machine control systems. Customers range from those needing simple accessory integration to full machine solutions, including obsolete product redevelopment.

The company states its differentiation lies in deep technical experience across all building blocks of electrical architecture, enabling intelligent harness designs that pack more functionality into less space. It also highlights a client-first process that begins with small projects to build trust, transparent project management, and a commitment to quality, integrity, and cost-effective responsiveness.
